findings.title: On a phone the match setup is off-screen and the footer covers the last seats
findings.detail: At 390x844 the lobby shows 12 seat tiles first and the whole Match block (Mode/Map/Seats readout, map cards, Random, Mode and Sides pickers) is below the fold with nothing showing that more follows. The fixed footer (Back/Loadout/Settings/Start) sits over seats 11-12 and the 'Bots fill the match to 4v4' note. The obvious next step is Start, pressed without seeing which map or mode will load. Closest rule is MENU-01: the one next step is clear, but not what it will do. DESIGN.md also says a block on the left is answered by readouts.
findings.evidence: bot-lobby@phone.dom.json has no Match texts in the viewport. Seat 12 'Open seat' at [67,773] and the note at [16,822,352,38] sit under the footer (controls BACK [16,718,111,44], START [16,774,358,58]). contrast.md gives 'Open seat' and '12' 1.3:1 (fail), and the note p10 1.3.
findings.fix: On narrow widths put the Mode/Map/Seats readout strip (or the whole Match block) above the seat list, and fold the 12 seats into a compact two-column grid or a single 'You + 7 bots' line that expands. Give the scrolling body bottom padding equal to the footer height.

findings.title: Selected uses three different treatments, and mint marks the 'You' slot, which is neither actionable nor a choice
findings.detail: The picked map card has a mint outline. The picked Mode and Sides segments are filled cream (#f3f1ea with ink text), not signal. The 'You' seat, which you can't click or pick, gets the mint outline and the 4 px mint bar. DESIGN.md says signal marks what can be acted on or the one selected choice, and pickers are .ds-seg with one choice lit. Here 'selected' has two looks and mint also means 'you'. The two cream blocks are also the brightest shapes on the screen and compete with the mint Start.
findings.evidence: Screenshot: SURVIVAL TOWN card mint border at [1344,287,168,128]; TEAM DEATHMATCH [1345,522,172,44] and MIXED TEAMS [1345,716,259,44] cream fill (text colour 11,14,19); 'You' slot mint frame and bar at ~[56,192,608,52]. Same on bot-lobby@phone (You slot ~[16,187,358,46]).
findings.fix: Pick one 'selected' treatment for every picker: a signal-dim fill with a signal edge on segments and map cards alike. Mark the player's own seat with weight or text ('You', heading size) and a neutral raised step, not signal.

findings.title: Map cards carry eyebrow labels ('Picked', 'Map') that are hard to read over the thumbnails
findings.detail: Each map card puts a 13 px label above the name: 'Map' twice, which tells you nothing, and 'Picked', the only selected-state text. DESIGN.md forbids eyebrows over headings. Over the bright thumbnail 'Picked' fails contrast, so the one word that carries state is the hardest to read. The card names are also set in uppercase while the readout above says 'Survival Town' in sentence case.
findings.evidence: contrast.md bot-lobby@desktop: 'Picked' [1359,340,39,13] p50 3.56, p10 2.67 (fail, needs 4.5). 'Map' [1711,361,24,13] p10 3.8 (warn).
findings.fix: Drop the 'Map' eyebrows. Show the picked state with the shared selected treatment (see the COL-03 finding) and put the name on a bottom-edge text scrim on every card so it clears 4.5:1 at p10.

findings.title: Changing numbers use proportional digits: the 84 px loading percentage, seats, slider values
findings.detail: '42%' counts up at 84 px without tabular figures, so the 'Building the map...' status line next to it moves sideways on every tick. The same goes for the Seats readout '8 / 12' and the slot numbers 01-12 (bot lobby), and for the slider values 10.00 / 1.00 / 12 / 0.07 (settings), which change while you drag. DESIGN.md requires tabular-nums on all numbers. Only the main menu's readouts have it.
findings.evidence: DOM tabular:false on loading '42%' [56,894,149,84] (also phone [16,696,113,64]); bot-lobby '8 / 12' [1758,233,53,22], slot numbers '11' w=9 against '08' w=15; settings span.val '10.00' w=30, '1.00' w=23, '0.07' w=25.
findings.fix: Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to .val, readout values, .n slot numbers and the loading figure, or put it on the shared readout/value classes in theme.ts.

findings.title: Sliders are 20 px tall: too small to hit on touch, and short for a mouse
findings.detail: Every range input in Settings has a 20 px hit box: 44 px is needed on touch and 32 px with a mouse. On the main menu the Name input element is also only 25 px tall, inside a 43 px visual box, so a tap on the box's top or bottom edge misses it.
findings.evidence: contrast.md small targets: settings@phone 'Mouse sensitivity' 252x20, 'ADS sensitivity multiplier' 252x20; settings@desktop six sliders 284x20; main-menu desktop and phone 'Name' input 206x25.
findings.fix: Make each slider's input (or a wrapping label) fill the row height, at least 44 px on touch and 32 px on desktop, keeping the drawn track thin. Make the Name input fill its visual box.

findings.title: Nothing has focus when Settings, the Bot Match lobby or the error dialog opens
findings.detail: Each of these screens advertises keyboard control in its footer hints (arrows Move, Enter Select, Esc Back), but focus lands nowhere and no row is highlighted, so the first arrow press starts from an unknown place. On the error dialog, Enter should retry by default. The main menu passes: its lit row (Bot Match) is visible.
findings.evidence: "focused": null in settings@desktop, bot-lobby@desktop and error@desktop .dom.json. In the screenshots no control on these screens is highlighted except the selected tab, picker and map state.
findings.fix: When a screen opens, focus its first sensible control: the Controls tab or the first setting row, Start in the lobby, Try again in the error dialog. Give it the same 4 px signal bar the main menu uses.

findings.title: A rounded 'WebGPU' debug badge sits on top of the game title
findings.detail: On the phone main menu a grey, rounded 'WebGPU' badge overlaps the 'DUTY SHOOTER' h1 at the top-left. It breaks three DESIGN.md rules: square corners, no pill badges, and only information-bearing elements. It also sits inside the top safe area (HUD-03: 47 px on a 390x844 phone) and garbles the first word a player reads. It is not in the DOM text sample, so it is probably a renderer overlay.
findings.evidence: main-menu@phone.png, about (16,16)-(150,66) device px: 'WebGPU' drawn under and over the 'DUTY' glyphs. The h1 is at [16,18,290,40].
findings.fix: Hide the renderer badge outside dev or ?debug builds, or move it next to the 'dev' version tag at the bottom in --ds-type-small with square corners.

findings.title: Four 'Open seat' slots and 'Seats 8 / 12' in an offline 4v4 that nobody else can join
findings.detail: The lobby is offline ('Offline: you against 7 bots'), and the note says bots fill the match to 4v4, yet it shows 12 seats with four dashed 'Open seat' slots and a Seats readout of 8 / 12. Nothing can fill those seats, so the screen suggests a 6v6 or a wait for players. DESIGN.md: 'Don't show a number that isn't real', and a seat that bots fill reads 'Bot fills this seat'. The dashed frame itself is used correctly.
findings.evidence: Readout 'Seats' '8 / 12' [1758,211,53,44]; 'Open seat' rows 09-12 [680,308,608,226]; note 'Bots fill the match to 4v4...' [56,551,426,16]; status line 'Offline: you against 7 bots' [1681,75,183,16]. Same on phone, rows 09-12.
findings.fix: Show only the seats the chosen mode uses (8 for 4v4, so no open seats offline) and make the readout '8 / 8'. If seats do stay open for some modes, label them with what happens to them.

findings.title: Off-scale type sizes (12, 14, 15, 18, 20, 24, 84 px) alongside the five DESIGN.md steps
findings.detail: DESIGN.md allows five sizes: display 30-60, title 32-52, heading 22, body 16, small 13. Settings adds 14 (tabs, slider values), 15 (Back button) and 12 (crumb), so 12/13/14/15/16 sit within 1 px of each other. Elsewhere: the bot lobby has 12 (crumb), 20 ('You'; 18 on phone) and 24 (Start), the error dialog has 15 on both buttons, and loading has 84 px (64 on phone) for '42%', above the 60 px display ceiling.
findings.fix: Map every size to a theme.ts step: tabs, values and buttons to body 16 or small 13, crumb to small 13, 'You' to heading 22, Start to heading 22, and the loading figure to display (clamp at 60).

findings.title: 13 px sentence-case labels players have to read
findings.detail: The field labels 'Mode' and 'Sides' above the pickers, the readout labels Mode/Map/Seats, 'You + 7 bots', 'Your pick' and the slot numbers are all 13 px sentence case. TYP-01 allows 12-13 px only for short uppercase labels, and wants 14 px or more for anything that must be read. The same holds for Settings' 'Changes save as you make them' (13 px running sentence) and the main menu's 'Name' label. All of them pass contrast, so this is a size issue only.
findings.evidence: contrast.md size warns: bot-lobby@desktop 22, bot-lobby@phone 13, settings 1 ('Changes save as you make them' [1674,1037,190,13]), main-menu 2 ('Name' [1594,42,35,13]).
findings.fix: Raise --ds-type-small to 14 px, or set field labels in body 16. Keep 13 px for the uppercase key-hint captions only.

findings.title: Setting groups use a line and a surface step together
findings.detail: Each settings group is a --ds-panel fill with a 1px outline, plus 1px lines between rows. DESIGN.md: separate with a 1px line or a flat surface step, never both. The same doubling appears on the bot lobby 'You' slot (raised fill plus outline), on the Mode/Map/Seats readout strip (box with an outline on a panel fill, where DESIGN wants one strip split by lines) and on the error dialog's Main menu button (fill plus outline).
findings.evidence: settings@desktop.png Mouse group [56,208,980,229] and Controller group [56,535,980,343]: filled rows with an outer outline and row rules. bot-lobby readout [1344,196,520,73].
findings.fix: Keep the panel fill and drop the outer outline, using row lines only between rows if the step alone isn't enough, or drop the fill and keep the lines. Do the same on the readout strip and the secondary button.

findings.title: The crumb is a non-clickable eyebrow: tracked caps, a decorative mint dash, text-3 over the map
findings.detail: 'OFFLINE · PLAY' (and 'MAIN MENU' in Settings) sits above the h1 as small tracked capitals behind a mint dash, but it is not a control: it is missing from the controls list, and 'Offline · Play' is not a path you can go back along. That makes it an eyebrow over a heading. It breaks three DESIGN.md rules: no eyebrows, tracked caps only on controls, and signal never as decoration. It is also --ds-text-3 (142,150,163) at 12 px over the map scrim, where DESIGN.md asks for text-2 or brighter.
findings.evidence: DOM div.ds-crumb 'Offline · Play' [84,30,117,12] 12px upper, colour 142,150,163; Settings 'Main menu' [84,30,86,12]; neither appears in controls. A mint dash precedes it in all four lobby and settings screenshots.
findings.fix: Either make the crumb a real back link ('Main menu' as a button, with focus and hover) in text-2 at 13 px, with the dash in a neutral line colour, or remove it and let the h1 and the footer Back carry the orientation.
